platform.description: Social media platform to search. Default is 'combined'.

include_answer.description: Include AI-synthesized answer summary. Default false.

include_raw_content.description: Include full cleaned page content per result by executing advanced extraction. Default false.

include_images.description: Include images related to search results. Default false.

time_range.description: Filter results by time range (day, week, month, or year). Default is no filter.

search_depth.description: Search depth: 'basic' (fast, 1 credit) or 'advanced' (thorough, 2 credits). Default 'advanced'.

include_answer.description: Include AI-synthesized answer summary. Default false.

include_raw_content.description: Include full cleaned page content per result. Default false.

include_images.description: Include images related to query. Default false.

auto_parameters.description: Let Tavily auto-configure search parameters based on query intent. Default false.

query.description: Optional query to filter and rerank relevant chunks per source.

chunks_per_source.description: Number of content chunks (≤500 chars each) per source when query is given (default 3).

extract_depth.description: Extraction depth: 'basic' (default) or 'advanced' for JS-heavy pages.

include_images.description: Include images in extraction results. Default false.

url.description: Root URL (http/https) to start crawling from.

max_depth.description: Maximum link depth from root URL (default 1).

select_paths.description: Restrict crawl to these URL path prefixes (e.g. ["/docs/", "/blog/"]).

exclude_paths.description: Skip these URL path prefixes during crawl.

url.description: Root URL (http/https) to start mapping from.

max_depth.description: Maximum link depth to traverse (1–5, default 1).

instructions.description: Natural language instructions to guide the mapper's focus. Note: doubles credit cost per 10 pages.
